description: Default cradle-to-gate embodied-emission deductions per new activity-technology unit (HWT/IWT) or system (CWT/CWS), applied once per unit disseminated: upfront in the year of dissemination (Eq.18, technical lifetime < 5 y or by choice) or amortised evenly over the first crediting period (Eq.19, durable technologies). Transcribed 2026-09-21 from GS4GG PAA M400-12 V2.0 §9.2 Table 10 (p.36) and the embodied-factor parameter table (p.58, kg CO2e). The parameter table marks the values provisional pending the SI §3 LCA derivation and holds the 4,500 kg borehole figure for source verification. Answers the reviewer's comment 1.7 ([#208], [#209]).
unit: tCO2e per unit (HWT/IWT) or per system (CWT/CWS)

amortisationYears.cite: V2 §9.2.2.1(b) p.37 — amortised over the first crediting period (5 years)

basic-filter.label: Basic filters (ceramic, sand, dispensers)

new-borehole-mechanised.label: New borehole / mechanised system
